summary.intent: Run a full GSD docs-update workflow on the cipher-box monorepo to generate 9 canonical docs, 2 gap docs, 12 per-package READMEs, and accuracy-verify all existing hand-written specs against the live codebase.
summary.outcome: 28 files committed to branch docs/gsd-docs-update (+2666/-467 lines); all 383+ verified claims passed after two fix-loop iterations and manual inline corrections for the 5 agents that died in a mid-session process restart.

repo: Types package was renamed: `packages/crypto/src/` → `packages/core/src/` — 15+ doc references to the old path were stale
Rust crypto module was removed from `apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/crypto/`; Rust logic now lives in `crates/core/src/`
`folder.service.ts` does not exist anywhere; web folder mutation logic lives in `apps/web/src/hooks/useFolderMutations.ts`
TEE republish interval is 6 hours (`REPUBLISH_INTERVAL_HOURS = 6` in republish.service.ts), not 3 hours as documented in CAPACITY.md
`folder_ipns` table has `IDX_folder_ipns_user_id` on `user_id` and a unique constraint on `(user_id, ipns_name)` — no standalone `ipns_name` index and no `owner_public_key` column
8 load test scenario files import `checkThresholds`, not 5 as documented (adds `sdk-folder-read`, `sdk-ipns-contention`, `sdk-upload-pipeline`)
`crates/core/src/file.rs` is an 11-line re-export shim — `FileMetadata` and `VersionEntry` Rust structs are actually defined in `crates/core/src/folder.rs`
`VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS` is not a named constant; it is a runtime struct field `version_cooldown_ms` in `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs:554`
`QUOTA_BYTES` is defined in `crates/fuse/src/constants.rs` for the FUSE layer; `vault.service.ts` only uses `QUOTA_LIMIT_BYTES`
`recovery.html` enforces hex-only private key input and explicitly rejects v1 folder format — VAULT_EXPORT_FORMAT.md documented both as supported
DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL was missing 2 of 16 migrations: `AddSignedRecordToFolderIpns` and `AddPublicKeyToFolderIpns`
`docker/docker-compose.yml` includes a `someguy` delegated-routing service on port 8190 not previously documented in DEVELOPMENT.md
`crates/fuse` uses `fuser = { version = "0.16" }` as a Cargo dependency; the patched vendored source is at `apps/desktop/src-tauri/vendor/fuser/src/channel.rs`, not inside the crate itself

code.finding: TypeORM synchronize/migrations/migrationsRun config (DATABASE_EVOLUTION_PROTOCOL had stale line refs 85-87)
FileMetadata Rust struct — file.rs is a re-export shim only
VersionEntry Rust struct — file.rs is a re-export shim only
version_cooldown_ms runtime struct field (no named constant VERSION_COOLDOWN_MS exists)
Vendored fuser source with FUSE-T socket patch; not inside crates/fuse
Hex-only private key restriction for v2 recovery (base64 not supported)

workflow: Background agents can die on transient API errors (socket closed, stream idle timeout) but sometimes auto-recover and complete — always check if the output file was written before relaunching to avoid a duplicate overwrite race
When an original agent recovers after a respawn is already running, use TaskStop immediately on the duplicate; both will write to the same path
Process restarts kill all in-flight background agents; on resume, check on-disk state and apply remaining fixes inline rather than re-spawning
GSD manifest at `.planning/tmp/docs-work-manifest.json` is the source of truth for wave/status tracking across agent restarts
Markdownlint MD040 (code fence missing language tag) is a common violation in generated docs and is enforced by lint-staged at commit time
Fix-loop iteration 2 can surface new findings at deeper scan depth (e.g. line ranges, additional stale file paths) not caught in iteration 1

friction: Two Wave 1 agents (ARCHITECTURE, CONFIGURATION) died on transient API errors mid-run; relaunching created a duplicate-write race when the originals auto-recovered, requiring TaskStop
A mid-session process restart killed all 5 iteration-2 fix agents simultaneously, requiring manual inline corrections for METADATA_SCHEMAS Rust line ranges and the other 4 docs

METADATA_SCHEMAS fixer in iteration 2 cited `crates/core/src/file.rs` for FileMetadata/VersionEntry, which is a re-export shim — introduced new wrong line ranges that the re-verifier caught, requiring a third manual pass
`agent-skills` query returned empty on first invocation (minor — workflow continued without it)
TaskStop calls for the two orphaned Wave-1 respawns silently failed because those agents had already died with the previous process exit
